subject: Cross-wave demo scheduling + ops for Acme Cloud (rotating windows)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Cross-wave demo scheduling + ops for Acme Cloud (rotating windows)

Hi Jane and team,

Thanks again for the discovery call last week — excited to get a live walkthrough in front of your platform and security folks. Given the global spread of participants (US, EU, APAC) I propose we set up a short five-demo rotation so folks in each region occasionally get a convenient window.

Goal: 45-minute product demo (core flows) + optional 15-minute security deep-dive for your security/infra attendees.

Three candidate windows (all times shown in your local TZ, please confirm which overlap works):
- Option A: 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT / 01:00 SGT (next day) — favors US mornings & EMEA afternoon
- Option B: 18:30 PT / 21:30 ET / 02:30 GMT / 10:30 SGT — favors APAC early day rotation
- Option C: 12:00 PT / 15:00 ET / 20:00 GMT / 05:00 SGT (next day) — middle-ground overlap

Can you confirm which options your engineers + procurement/security could attend? If none of the above work I can push a rotating schedule so we alternate the demo start time weekly.

I've cc'd Dylan (SE) to confirm the agenda and Laura (sales) for procurement and credits approvals if we need to bend hours. I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) to show the proposed sequence and deliverables.

Attachments: [attachment: MAP-v1.pdf (23KB)]

Next steps: please reply with preferred option(s) and any absolute blackout windows. I'll draft calendar invites once we lock the first three rotations.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — Production-Grade LLM Inference (developer-first)

Vanessa,

Thanks — appreciate the options. Quick constraints from our side:
- Platform engineers (EMEA-focused) prefer no meetings before 14:00 GMT on Tuesdays/Thursdays (on-call rotation).
- Security can join for any slot but prefers at least one week notice for deep dives.
- Procurement needs the final MAP + SOW to review before committing to PO timelines.

From a raw availability perspective the following windows work for the core team: Option A (occasionally) and Option C (best overall). Option B is tricky on our side due to local team hours.

To speed scheduling, procurement@acme.com asked that we loop them and provided potential PO lead time (we can turn around a PO in ~5 business days once MAP + SOW are in).

If you can lock 3 rotating slots and confirm security deep-dive agenda, we'll sign off.

—Jane

Thanks Vanessa — and thanks Jane.

I can run the demo and the security deep-dive. My suggested format:
- 0–5 min: intros and success criteria (Vanessa)
- 5–40 min: live demo of inference pipeline, latency/cost dashboards, and routing/fallbacks (me)
- 40–55 min: targeted security/arch discussion (me + Acme security)
- 55–60 min: wrap & next steps (Vanessa)

If Option C is the best overall, I recommend we implement a rotating cadence where:
- Week 1: Slot C (mid-day overlap)
- Week 2: Slot A (EMEA-afternoon / US-morning)
- Week 3: Slot B (APAC-friendly)
- Then repeat.

This gives each region at least one convenient demo every three weeks. I'll prepare a short security appendix (bullet list of artifacts: SOC2 report, access controls, network architecture) to attach to the MAP so procurement has what they need.

Draft calendar (I created a provisional calendar poll): https://doodle.com/poll/abc123 — please mark your availability and I'll convert the winning times into recurring events.

—Dylan
